title: Whole Deep Lobed Semicells and Narrow Isthmus Desmid
description: One wholly newly authored enlarged Micrasterias-like desmid exterior, as a single complete closed editable mesh. Two opposite flattened semicells remain joined by a real narrow median isthmus. Each half expands into one broad polar region and four principal lateral regions separated by deep open sinuses; secondary terminal forks and small edge denticles create a bilateral dissected silhouette. Broad faces gently swell into finite thickness and join through continuous edge walls. This is not a flat image card, cut-up leaf, repainted liverwort thallus, repeated perforated diatom valve or renamed old cell: all outline points and conforming planar triangles were authored anew. One entire unicellular green-alga teaching model, zero scenes, three restrained opaque green surface roles. Generic stylised exterior at arbitrary roughly ten-centimetre display size, not an exact Micrasterias species or specimen, measured natural scale, true wall-layer reconstruction or proof of every natural terminal detail. No chloroplast, nucleus, pyrenoid, cytoplasmic contents, nanoscopic pores, optical transparency, growth, cell division, reproduction or physical stability simulation. The bottommost full-cell surface is only a display datum. No rig, labels, texture, animation or interaction.
